title: Aurora PostgreSQL compute and shared distributed storage
description: Simplified Aurora PostgreSQL persistent storage read path. Postgres, CPU and memory reside in the DB instance; uncached persistent reads use a separate shared distributed SSD-backed cluster volume. Memory/cache hits and eligible Optimized Reads caches are omitted, as are Aurora HA and replication. Heavy I/O demand can increase storage waits and affect application responsiveness; this is conditional, not a diagnosis of every Aurora workload. No latency estimate is asserted.
